articles.title: Indian bonds nudge up on oil dip; debt sale weighs

articles.title: Delta Corp shares tank 16%. What’s triggering the sharp selloff?
articles.content: Shares of Delta Corp tumbled 16% after the Supreme Court upheld the government’s retrospective 28% GST levy on online gaming companies. The apex court ruled that online gaming platforms qualify as actionable claims under GST law and backed retrospective application of the amendments. Gaming firms had opposed the tax demand, arguing it contradicts decades of legal precedent distinguishing gaming from gambling.

articles.title: Infosys, Wipro, TCS, other IT stocks jump up to 4%: What’s behind the bullish sentiment in a muted market?
articles.content: IT stocks, including Infosys and TCS, surged up to 4% on Friday, driven by Wipro's expanded partnership with ServiceNow to scale AI workflows. This collaboration aims to integrate Wipro Intelligence with ServiceNow's AI Platform, streamlining enterprise operations and accelerating AI adoption. The move boosted investor confidence in Indian IT companies, despite earlier concerns about AI advancements.

articles.title: Did LIC shares really crash 50% in one day? Here's how the bonus math works
articles.content: LIC shares appeared to fall nearly 50% on Friday after adjusting for its first-ever 1:1 bonus issue, though the actual decline was only around 1.5%. The insurer issued one bonus share for every existing share held by eligible shareholders, with May 29 fixed as the record date for the corporate action.

articles.title: Wockhardt shares jump 8%, extend rally after CDSCO nod for Zaynich antibiotic

articles.title: West Asia conflict a stagflationary shock; world economy not ready for a long war: Bank of America
articles.content: The West Asia conflict has triggered a stagflationary shock, impacting global growth and inflation. Oil prices are expected to remain elevated, impacting energy importers, while central banks face difficult decisions.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan inflation remains below BOJ target as energy costs rise
articles.content: Tokyo's inflation eased for a sixth month in May, staying under the Bank of Japan's target. Government subsidies helped cushion rising global energy costs. Policymakers watch these trends closely as they consider future interest rate decisions amid global economic pressures.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Bond market selloff challenges traditional safe-haven role of Treasuries
articles.content: Government bonds are no longer a safe haven during stock market drops. Investors are demanding higher returns due to inflation fears and economic growth. Investors are becoming more selective about bond duration.

articles.title: Silver drops Rs 1,500/kg, gold at Rs 1.56 lakh/10 gms as Iran war tensions weigh. Key levels to watch

articles.title: Rupee rises 5 paise to 95.53 against US dollar in early trade
articles.content: The Indian Rupee gained ground against the US Dollar today. This rise follows an agreement between the US and Iran to extend a ceasefire.  Forex traders believe this will ensure continued trade through the Strait of Hormuz.  Stable oil prices offer relief to India, an oil-importing nation.  However, foreign investment flows remain a key challenge for the Rupee's stability.

articles.title: US Stock Market: US growth revised lower; inflation remains elevated
articles.content: The US first-quarter GDP growth was revised down to 1.6%, indicating a slowdown driven by weaker consumer spending and inventory investment. Meanwhile, April's inflation remained elevated, with the PCE price index rising 3.8% year-on-year.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Hawkish Fed voices grow louder amid energy-driven inflation surge
articles.content: A growing split is seen among US Federal Reserve officials. Some policymakers warn that interest rates might need to increase again. This comes as inflation shows signs of not cooling down quickly enough. Rising energy prices linked to the Iran conflict are a major concern. The impact of artificial intelligence on productivity is also being debated.
